summary: The repository state, workspace patch evidence, and deterministic post-actor validation agree that the obsolete support-agent setup was coherently retired while remaining project context was preserved.

requirements.evidence: Current moldea/moldea.yaml contains only version 1 and the /moldea/project.md context relationship; it has no support agent, binding, runtimeAgent entry, /src/support-agent.ts reference, or custom runtime guidance. The canonical files moldea/agents/support/description.md, moldea/agents/support/instruction.md, and moldea/runtimes/custom.md are absent. Runner-owned workspace assertions show those three files existed before and are absent after, with moldea/moldea.yaml changed, while moldea/project.md and other project files retained identical hashes. The current project context states that the former support agent was removed, and src/support-agent.ts is absent. Deterministic validation passed with CLI 7.0.1/schema 4, zero diagnostics, successful typechecking, repository equivalence, and no repository mutation.
